# Afterkeep: full content

> General information, not legal advice. Facts checked against official sources on 15 Oct 2026.

## Bitwarden (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/bitwarden/

The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set. Best for: Budget-conscious people who want a proper, tested emergency-access workflow.

Key facts:
- Category: Vaults & password managers
- Pricing: Free plan available; Emergency Access requires Premium or a paid Families/Teams/Enterprise plan. Check current pricing.
- Best for: Budget-conscious people who want a proper, tested emergency-access workflow.
- Emergency contacts only need a free Bitwarden account
- Choose View-only or Takeover access with a custom wait time
- Pros: Emergency contacts only need a free Bitwarden account; Choose View-only or Takeover access with a custom wait time; Open-source and independently audited; No limit on the number of emergency contacts
- Cons: Contact must be on the same Bitwarden server region (US/EU); Can't add or edit contacts if Premium lapses (existing ones still work); Interface is functional rather than polished

Sources: https://bitwarden.com/help/emergency-access/

Q: Is Bitwarden good for digital legacy planning?
A: The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set.

Q: Who is Bitwarden best for?
A: Budget-conscious people who want a proper, tested emergency-access workflow.

Q: How much does Bitwarden cost?
A: Free plan available; Emergency Access requires Premium or a paid Families/Teams/Enterprise plan. Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of Bitwarden?
A: Contact must be on the same Bitwarden server region (US/EU); Can't add or edit contacts if Premium lapses (existing ones still work); Interface is functional rather than polished.

Q: What are alternatives to Bitwarden?
A: Alternatives in the same category include 1Password, Keeper, LastPass Emergency Access.


## 1Password (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/1password/

Excellent password manager, but it has no automatic emergency-access feature. Legacy planning relies on the Emergency Kit and family account recovery. Best for: Families who will store the Emergency Kit with their will and use a Families plan, where an organiser can help recover members' accounts.

Key facts:
- Category: Vaults & password managers
- Pricing: Paid plans only (free trial). Check current pricing.
- Best for: Families who will store the Emergency Kit with their will and use a Families plan, where an organiser can help recover members' accounts.
- Printable Emergency Kit with your sign-in details and Secret Key
- Families plan lets organisers recover family members' accounts
- Pros: Printable Emergency Kit with your sign-in details and Secret Key; Families plan lets organisers recover family members' accounts; Strong security model and polished apps
- Cons: No time-delayed emergency contact feature; The Emergency Kit has to be stored securely and kept current; No free tier

Sources: https://support.1password.com/emergency-kit/

Q: Is 1Password good for digital legacy planning?
A: Excellent password manager, but it has no automatic emergency-access feature. Legacy planning relies on the Emergency Kit and family account recovery.

Q: Who is 1Password best for?
A: Families who will store the Emergency Kit with their will and use a Families plan, where an organiser can help recover members' accounts.

Q: How much does 1Password cost?
A: Paid plans only (free trial). Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of 1Password?
A: No time-delayed emergency contact feature; The Emergency Kit has to be stored securely and kept current; No free tier.

Q: What are alternatives to 1Password?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Bitwarden, Keeper, LastPass Emergency Access.


## Keeper (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/keeper/

A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period. Best for: People who want emergency access alongside business-grade security features.

Key facts:
- Category: Vaults & password managers
- Pricing: Paid plans with a free trial. Check current pricing.
- Best for: People who want emergency access alongside business-grade security features.
- Up to 5 emergency contacts, each with an optional access delay of up to 3 months
- Mature apps on every platform
- Pros: Up to 5 emergency contacts, each with an optional access delay of up to 3 months; Mature apps on every platform; Extra add-ons for secure file storage
- Cons: Add-ons can increase the total cost; Contacts need a Keeper account to accept access; Emergency Access is for consumer accounts only, not business accounts

Sources: https://docs.keeper.io/en/user-guides/emergency-access

Q: Is Keeper good for digital legacy planning?
A: A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period.

Q: Who is Keeper best for?
A: People who want emergency access alongside business-grade security features.

Q: How much does Keeper cost?
A: Paid plans with a free trial. Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of Keeper?
A: Add-ons can increase the total cost; Contacts need a Keeper account to accept access; Emergency Access is for consumer accounts only, not business accounts.

Q: What are alternatives to Keeper?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass Emergency Access.


## LastPass Emergency Access (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/lastpass-emergency-access/

It works: contacts can request vault access after a wait period. LastPass's 2022 security breaches are a good reason to look at alternatives first, though. Best for: Existing LastPass users who want to add emergency contacts without switching.

Key facts:
- Category: Vaults & password managers
- Pricing: Emergency Access is a paid-plan feature. Check current pricing.
- Best for: Existing LastPass users who want to add emergency contacts without switching.
- Long-standing emergency access with a wait timer
- Owner can decline a request during the wait period; otherwise access is granted automatically
- Pros: Long-standing emergency access with a wait timer; Owner can decline a request during the wait period; otherwise access is granted automatically; Familiar to many families
- Cons: Significant 2022 security incidents involving encrypted vault data; Feature availability depends on plan; Contacts need their own LastPass account

Sources: https://www.lastpass.com/features/emergency-access

Q: Is LastPass Emergency Access good for digital legacy planning?
A: It works: contacts can request vault access after a wait period. LastPass's 2022 security breaches are a good reason to look at alternatives first, though.

Q: Who is LastPass Emergency Access best for?
A: Existing LastPass users who want to add emergency contacts without switching.

Q: How much does LastPass Emergency Access cost?
A: Emergency Access is a paid-plan feature. Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of LastPass Emergency Access?
A: Significant 2022 security incidents involving encrypted vault data; Feature availability depends on plan; Contacts need their own LastPass account.

Q: What are alternatives to LastPass Emergency Access?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Bitwarden, 1Password, Keeper.


## Dashlane (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/dashlane/

Not recommended for legacy access. Dashlane removed its Emergency Contact feature and now suggests sharing an exported vault file with a trusted person. Best for: People who use Dashlane for day-to-day passwords and plan legacy access some other way.

Key facts:
- Category: Vaults & password managers
- Pricing: Check current pricing.
- Best for: People who use Dashlane for day-to-day passwords and plan legacy access some other way.
- Polished, easy-to-use apps
- Account Recovery Key helps you regain access if you forget your master password
- Pros: Polished, easy-to-use apps; Account Recovery Key helps you regain access if you forget your master password
- Cons: No emergency contact or dead-man's-switch feature; The export-and-share workaround goes stale as passwords change; The recovery key is for the account owner, not for heirs

Sources: https://support.dashlane.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407179219986-Share-your-data-with-a-trusted-person

Q: Is Dashlane good for digital legacy planning?
A: Not recommended for legacy access. Dashlane removed its Emergency Contact feature and now suggests sharing an exported vault file with a trusted person.

Q: Who is Dashlane best for?
A: People who use Dashlane for day-to-day passwords and plan legacy access some other way.

Q: How much does Dashlane cost?
A: Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of Dashlane?
A: No emergency contact or dead-man's-switch feature; The export-and-share workaround goes stale as passwords change; The recovery key is for the account owner, not for heirs.

Q: What are alternatives to Dashlane?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Bitwarden, 1Password, Keeper.


## Google Inactive Account Manager (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/google-inactive-account-manager/

Free and essential if you use Google. Set it up today: after a period of inactivity you choose, Google notifies up to 10 people and can share selected data with them. Best for: Anyone with Gmail, Google Photos or Google Drive.

Key facts:
- Category: Platform legacy settings
- Pricing: Free.
- Best for: Anyone with Gmail, Google Photos or Google Drive.
- Free and takes about 5 minutes
- Choose which data (Photos, Drive, Gmail and more) each contact can download
- Pros: Free and takes about 5 minutes; Choose which data (Photos, Drive, Gmail and more) each contact can download; Can delete the account after notifying contacts
- Cons: Only triggers on inactivity, not on proof of death; Contacts download data; they don't take over the account

Sources: https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/3036546

Q: Is Google Inactive Account Manager good for digital legacy planning?
A: Free and essential if you use Google. Set it up today: after a period of inactivity you choose, Google notifies up to 10 people and can share selected data with them.

Q: Who is Google Inactive Account Manager best for?
A: Anyone with Gmail, Google Photos or Google Drive.

Q: How much does Google Inactive Account Manager cost?
A: Free.

Q: What are the downsides of Google Inactive Account Manager?
A: Only triggers on inactivity, not on proof of death; Contacts download data; they don't take over the account.

Q: What are alternatives to Google Inactive Account Manager?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Apple Legacy Contact.


## Apple Legacy Contact (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/apple-legacy-contact/

Free and essential for iPhone users. Without it, even close family can find it very hard to get into iCloud photos and data. Best for: Anyone storing photos, messages or files in iCloud.

Key facts:
- Category: Platform legacy settings
- Pricing: Free (requires an Apple Account and a supported OS version).
- Best for: Anyone storing photos, messages or files in iCloud.
- Free, built into Settings
- You can add more than one Legacy Contact, and they don't need an Apple device
- Pros: Free, built into Settings; You can add more than one Legacy Contact, and they don't need an Apple device; Contacts get an access key; Apple verifies the death certificate
- Cons: Excludes iCloud Keychain (passwords, passkeys, payment info) and purchased movies, music, books and subscriptions; Access is time-limited after approval (check Apple's page for details)

Sources: https://support.apple.com/en-us/102631

Q: Is Apple Legacy Contact good for digital legacy planning?
A: Free and essential for iPhone users. Without it, even close family can find it very hard to get into iCloud photos and data.

Q: Who is Apple Legacy Contact best for?
A: Anyone storing photos, messages or files in iCloud.

Q: How much does Apple Legacy Contact cost?
A: Free (requires an Apple Account and a supported OS version).

Q: What are the downsides of Apple Legacy Contact?
A: Excludes iCloud Keychain (passwords, passkeys, payment info) and purchased movies, music, books and subscriptions; Access is time-limited after approval (check Apple's page for details).

Q: What are alternatives to Apple Legacy Contact?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Google Inactive Account Manager.

- Cons: US-focused; not suitable for most other countries; Not a replacement for a lawyer in complex estates

## Prisidio (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/prisidio/

A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR. Best for: US households who want one shared vault for documents, valuables and stories.

Key facts:
- Category: Estate & document tools
- Pricing: Check current pricing.
- Best for: US households who want one shared vault for documents, valuables and stories.
- Co-Owner plus Keyholder handover model
- CLEAR identity verification for designees (added May 2026)
- Pros: Co-Owner plus Keyholder handover model; CLEAR identity verification for designees (added May 2026); Activity log and reminders for expiring documents
- Cons: After release, Keyholders get time-limited, view/download-only access (one year, per Prisidio's terms); US-focused identity verification

Sources: https://www.prisidio.com

Q: Is Prisidio good for digital legacy planning?
A: A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR.

Q: Who is Prisidio best for?
A: US households who want one shared vault for documents, valuables and stories.

Q: How much does Prisidio cost?
A: Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of Prisidio?
A: After release, Keyholders get time-limited, view/download-only access (one year, per Prisidio's terms); US-focused identity verification.

Q: What are alternatives to Prisidio?

## Casa (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/casa/

A leading multisig self-custody service with inheritance included in every plan, covering bitcoin, ETH and stablecoins. Best for: Bitcoin holders who want self-custody plus a guided inheritance plan.

Key facts:
- Category: Crypto inheritance
- Pricing: From $250/yr (Standard); Premium $2,100/yr; Private Client $7,500/yr (USD). Check current pricing.
- Best for: Bitcoin holders who want self-custody plus a guided inheritance plan.
- Multisig removes the single point of failure
- Inheritance included at no extra cost; recipients only need an email
- Pros: Multisig removes the single point of failure; Inheritance included at no extra cost; recipients only need an email; Six-month verification period after a claim, so the owner can cancel a false claim
- Cons: Ongoing membership cost; Heirs still need some setup and guidance

Sources: https://casa.io

Q: Is Casa good for digital legacy planning?
A: A leading multisig self-custody service with inheritance included in every plan, covering bitcoin, ETH and stablecoins.

## Vault12 Guard (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/vault12/

Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals. Best for: Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.

Key facts:
- Category: Crypto inheritance
- Pricing: Check current pricing.
- Best for: Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.
- Works with any blockchain and wallet
- Guardians hold encrypted shards, not the full seed
- Pros: Works with any blockchain and wallet; Guardians hold encrypted shards, not the full seed; Nothing stored on Vault12 servers or in the cloud
- Cons: Guardians must install the app and stay reachable; Social-recovery setups need regular health checks

Sources: https://vault12.com/product/inheritance/

Q: Is Vault12 Guard good for digital legacy planning?
A: Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.

Q: Who is Vault12 Guard best for?
A: Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.

Q: How much does Vault12 Guard cost?
A: Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of Vault12 Guard?
A: Guardians must install the app and stay reachable; Social-recovery setups need regular health checks.

Q: What are alternatives to Vault12 Guard?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Casa, Unchained, Ledger Recover.


## Ledger Recover (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/ledger-recover/

An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool. Best for: Ledger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.

Key facts:
- Category: Crypto inheritance
- Pricing: Paid subscription (Ledger has advertised $9.99/month). Check current pricing.
- Best for: Ledger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.
- Encrypted seed split across three companies
- Recover with ID on a new Ledger device
- Pros: Encrypted seed split across three companies; Recover with ID on a new Ledger device; A trusted-contact option is sold on Ledger's store
- Cons: Requires government ID verification; Controversial with self-custody purists; Availability depends on the country your ID was issued in

Sources: https://www.ledger.com/ledger-recover

Q: Is Ledger Recover good for digital legacy planning?
A: An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool.

Q: Who is Ledger Recover best for?
A: Ledger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.

Q: How much does Ledger Recover cost?
A: Paid subscription (Ledger has advertised $9.99/month). Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of Ledger Recover?
A: Requires government ID verification; Controversial with self-custody purists; Availability depends on the country your ID was issued in.

Q: What are alternatives to Ledger Recover?
A: Alternatives in the same category include Casa, Unchained, Vault12 Guard.


## Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access) (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/proton-pass/

A solid privacy-first option: on any paid Proton plan you can name up to five emergency contacts who get access automatically after a wait time you choose, unless you deny the request. Best for: Proton users who want one emergency process covering Proton Mail, Pass and Drive.

Key facts:
- Category: Vaults & password managers
- Pricing: Emergency Access is included on all paid Proton plans, including Proton Pass Plus. Check current pricing.
- Best for: Proton users who want one emergency process covering Proton Mail, Pass and Drive.
- Up to 5 emergency contacts
- Wait time of 1, 2, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days
- Pros: Up to 5 emergency contacts; Wait time of 1, 2, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days; You're notified of every request and can deny it; Covers your whole Proton Account, including emails, passwords and files
- Cons: Both you and your contact need a Proton Mail address; Paid plans only; Longest wait time is 30 days

Sources: https://proton.me/support/emergency-access, https://proton.me/support/proton-pass-plans-explained

Q: Is Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access) good for digital legacy planning?
A: A solid privacy-first option: on any paid Proton plan you can name up to five emergency contacts who get access automatically after a wait time you choose, unless you deny the request.

Q: Who is Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access) best for?
A: Proton users who want one emergency process covering Proton Mail, Pass and Drive.

Q: How much does Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access) cost?
A: Emergency Access is included on all paid Proton plans, including Proton Pass Plus. Check current pricing.

Q: What are the downsides of Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access)?
A: Both you and your contact need a Proton Mail address; Paid plans only; Longest wait time is 30 days.

Q: What are alternatives to Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access)?

## Bitkey (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/bitkey/

A bitcoin-only 2-of-3 multisig wallet with built-in inheritance: your beneficiary starts a claim, and funds unlock only after a 6-month delay you can cancel. Best for: Bitcoin holders who want simple self-custody with inheritance built in.

Key facts:
- Category: Crypto inheritance
- Pricing: Hardware listed at $250 on bitkey.world. Check current pricing.
- Best for: Bitcoin holders who want simple self-custody with inheritance built in.
- Built-in inheritance with a 6-month security delay
- You get alerts and can cancel a claim
- Pros: Built-in inheritance with a 6-month security delay; You get alerts and can cancel a claim; No seed phrase; 2-of-3 multisig
- Cons: Bitcoin only; Beneficiary needs their own Bitkey device; Bitkey says a beneficiary isn't automatically the legal owner; your will may take precedence

Sources: https://support.bitkey.world/hc/en-us/articles/32141067207444-What-is-Inheritance-and-how-does-it-work, https://bitkey.world/

Q: Is Bitkey good for digital legacy planning?

Q: Who is Bitkey best for?

A: Hardware listed at $250 on bitkey.world. Check current pricing.

## Nunchuk (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/nunchuk/

Key facts:

- Pricing: Free DIY wallets; the inheritance plan (Honey Badger) is listed at 480/year. Check current pricing and currency.

- On-chain or off-chain timelock
- Beneficiary can claim without Nunchuk's involvement

- Cons: Inheritance needs a paid plan; Bitcoin only; Setup is more technical than a custodial service

## Liana (tool review)
URL: https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/liana/

A free, open-source bitcoin wallet from Wizardsardine with time-based recovery paths, so a family member or trusted contact can access funds if something happens to you. Best for: Technical bitcoin holders who want DIY inheritance with no company holding keys.

Key facts:
- Category: Crypto inheritance
- Pricing: Liana Wallet is free and open source; Liana Business is a paid service.
- Best for: Technical bitcoin holders who want DIY inheritance with no company holding keys.
- Free and open source
- Time-based recovery path for heirs
- Pros: Free and open source; Time-based recovery path for heirs; No third party holds your keys
- Cons: DIY setup with community support only (free edition); Bitcoin only; Heirs must follow the recovery path themselves

Sources: https://wizardsardine.com/liana/, https://wizardsardine.com/liana/wallet

A: A free, open-source bitcoin wallet from Wizardsardine with time-based recovery paths, so a family member or trusted contact can access funds if something happens to you.
